integrity: Self-contained unconditional proof for all odd primes, with separately specified finite checks and explicit source comparisons. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The complete formula is proved only for totient values 8q with q an odd prime; the exceptional q=3 and q=5 fibers were previously tabulated. No assertion is made for higher dyadic exponents, primality densities, or independent priority.
title: Exact inverse-totient fibers at \(\varphi(n)=8q\) for every odd prime \(q\)
